lines.japanese: 出入り口──つまりこちらへ接近してくる彼女の姿に気圧されてしまった俺は、とくに気の利いた言葉も思いつかず、ただ身の引きしまる思いで硬直していました。
lines.english: She was approaching the doorway—which meant approaching me—and her presence overwhelmed me. Unable to think of anything clever to say, I simply stood rigid, braced from head to toe.

lines.japanese: 「お、お疲れさまです！」
lines.english: “G-good work today!”

lines.japanese: 居たたまれなくなって深々と九十度のお辞儀。
lines.english: Overcome with embarrassment, I folded into a full ninety-degree bow.

lines.japanese: ハイ。反応とくになし、と。
lines.english: Right. No response to speak of.

lines.japanese: ふたたび頭を上げたときには、もう事務室に玉泉トレーナーの姿はありませんでした。
lines.english: By the time I raised my head again, Coach Tamaizumi had already vanished from the office.

lines.japanese: ううむ、なんというか……。
lines.english: Hmm. How to put it...

lines.japanese: 最初に会ったときよりは幾分マシであるものの、やっぱり依然として壁を感じるなあ。
lines.english: Things were somewhat better than when we first met, yet I could still feel a wall between us.

lines.japanese: 不肖・千歳鷲介──いみじくも外交官、渉外担当、コミュニケーション係ｅｔｃなんて役職名を冠したりもしたものですが、いまとなってはこの体たらく。
lines.english: And to think that I, Shusuke Chitose, once bore grand titles like diplomat, liaison officer, communications director, and so on. Just look at me now.

lines.japanese: 「俺も老いたねえ」
lines.english: “I really am getting old.”

lines.japanese: ははっ、そろそろ死期も近いってことかい？
lines.english: Hah. Perhaps my appointed hour was drawing near.

lines.japanese: あーあ、もう笑わば笑えだ。笑え笑え。
lines.english: Ah, well. Laugh if you like. Go on, laugh.

lines.japanese: 「ヘッ、笑えよ死神」
lines.english: “Heh. Laugh, Grim Reaper.”

lines.japanese: 「誰が死神だてめえ」
lines.english: “Who the hell are you calling the Grim Reaper?”

lines.japanese: うわ。毎度毎度ヤなタイミングで更衣室から出てくるよなあ、このひと……。
lines.english: Oh, man. How did she manage to come out of the changing room at the worst possible moment every single time...?

lines.japanese: 「あ……あー、お疲れさまです。いらしたんですか」
lines.english: “Oh... uh, good work today. You were still here?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　いや……お？　なにおまえ、泣いてた？」
lines.english: “What? No... Hm? Were you crying?”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　俺が？　いえ、まさか」
lines.english: “What? Me? Of course not.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだよねえ？　ごめんごめん、一瞬そう見えた。っちゃー、コンタクトに傷でも付いたかな……」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Sorry, sorry. For a second, I thought you were. Damn, did I scratch one of my contacts...?”

lines.japanese: 涙ぶくろに指を添えて、少し照れくさそうに苦笑いする英里子さん。
lines.english: Eriko touched a finger just below her eye and smiled, faintly embarrassed.

lines.japanese: なんとなくひとりで夜の下を歩くのが寂しくて俺は呼びかけました。
lines.english: The thought of walking alone beneath the night sky felt strangely lonely, so I called after her.

lines.japanese: 「英里子さん」
lines.english: “Eriko.”

lines.japanese: 「はー？」
lines.english: “Yeah?”

lines.japanese: 「もう帰るとこっすよね。ちょうど俺もなんで、駅まで一緒に行きましょう」
lines.english: “You’re going home now, right? So am I. Let’s walk to the station together.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　何それ、たまひよの代わり？」
lines.english: “What? Am I Tama-chick’s replacement?”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、そんなんじゃないっすよ。ただ、どうせ駅まで帰り道同じじゃないすか」
lines.english: “No, no, nothing like that. We take the same road to the station anyway.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ、そっか。でもごめん。今日はちょっと、友達と約束あって。駅と逆方向なんだ」
lines.english: “Hah. Fair enough. Sorry, though. I’m meeting a friend tonight, and I’m headed the other way.”

lines.japanese: 「あら羨ましい。もしかして素敵な男性とのおデートかしら」
lines.english: “My, how enviable. Could it be a date with some dashing gentleman?”

lines.japanese: 「んー？　オトコだったらもうちょっと気合入れてたかなァ」
lines.english: “Hmm? If it were a man, I might’ve put in a little more effort.”

lines.japanese: ぺぺし、ぺぺしと両頬を二度ずつ叩く英里子さん。
lines.english: Eriko gave each cheek two brisk pats.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、安心しときなよ。まだまだ日野英里子はみんなのえーりんだから」
lines.english: “You can rest easy. Eriko Hino is still Everybody’s Eirin.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ、英里子さんが彼氏作んないのって俺たちのためだったんだー。男子かんげきー」
lines.english: “Good heavens. So Eriko stays single for our sake. Men everywhere rejoice.”

lines.japanese: 「まあまあ落ちつけ落ちつけ」
lines.english: “Easy, easy. Calm down.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳ー、どうせおまえ、しばらくここでバイト続けんだろ？　今度は一緒に帰ってやるから、またいつでも誘えよ？」
lines.english: “Chitose, you’re going to keep working here for a while, right? I’ll walk home with you next time, so ask me again whenever you feel like it, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、ありがとうございます。じゃあ機会があれば」
lines.english: “Thank you. I will, if I get the chance.”

lines.japanese: 「おうっ。ほんじゃなー、おっ先ー！」
lines.english: “Right! See you later—I’m off!”

lines.japanese: 「はーいお疲れさまーっす」
lines.english: “Good night!”

lines.japanese: 口笛でも吹きかねないしれっとした表情で、英里子さんは風を切るように控え室を横切ってゆきました。
lines.english: With a look so nonchalant she might have started whistling at any moment, Eriko crossed the staff room at a brisk clip.

lines.japanese: さーて、俺もさっさと着替えて帰ろーっと。
lines.english: All right, I’d better hurry up, change, and head home myself.

lines.japanese: 「ははは。英里子さんったら、しばらくここでバイト続けんだろ？　だーってさ」
lines.english: “Hahaha. Listen to Eriko: ‘You’re going to keep working here for a while, right?’”

lines.japanese: 「どーなんでしょおねえ。知らないよ、そんなの。俺が聞きたいよ」
lines.english: “Who knooows? I certainly don’t. I’m the one who’d like an answer.”

lines.japanese: ねえ？　そうでしょう死神さん。
lines.english: Right? Don’t you agree, Mr. Grim Reaper?

lines.japanese: ふう。
lines.english: Phew.

lines.japanese: えーと、そんじゃ、まあ──
lines.english: Well, then—

lines.japanese: ──お休みなさい、またいつか。
lines.english: —good night. See you again someday.
